title: Chapter 1: Understanding International Relations
content:
✨ ሰላም ውድ የኢትዮጵያ ዩኒቨርሲቲዎች ፍሬሽማን ተማሪዎቻችን! እንኳን ወደ EthioFresh Global Trends & International Relations የቱቶሪያል ዝግጅት በሰላም መጣችሁ! እኛ የEthioFresh የትምህርት ባለሙያዎች ይህንን ጥልቅና አጠቃላይ የጥናት ኖት ያዘጋጀነው በምዕራፍ 1 ክፍል 4 (ከ1.7.1 እስከ ምዕራፉ ማጠቃለያ) ያሉትን የInternational Relations ቲዮሪዎች (Idealism/Liberalism, Realism, Structuralism/Marxism, Constructivism, እና Critical Theories) ከሞጁሉ ከተወሰዱት የምስል መረጃዎች ጋር በከፍተኛ ጥራት ተንትነን ለፈተናችሁ 100% ሙሉ ዝግጁ እንድትሆኑ ለማስቻል ነው። አብራችሁን እስከ መጨረሻው ዘልቃችሁ በማንበብ ለA+ ዝግጁ ሁኑ! 🚀

1.7. Theories of International Relations

The politics of global interactions is more accessible now in the present age than it ever has been in the past. Whether it is conflict in the Middle East, the break-up of Yugoslavia, human rights violations, or poverty in Sub-Saharan Africa, we are daily confronted by images of global interactions which cross-national boundaries, involve a variety of factors, and impact upon a widespread number of issues affecting our lives, values, and welfare. Theoretical perspectives in IR act as critical analytical lenses. They allow us to simplify, order, interpret, and make sense of complex international events through systematic theoretical frameworks.

👉 የአማርኛ ማብራሪያ (Amharic Explanation):

በአሁኑ ዘመን በዓለም ላይ የሚከሰቱ ክስተቶች (እንደ በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ያሉ ግጭቶች፣ የወደቀችው ዩጎዝላቪያ፣ የሰብአዊ መብት ጥሰቶች ወይም በሰሃራ በታች ባሉ የአፍሪካ ሀገራት ያለው ድህነት) የሁላችንንም ህይወትና ደህንነት በቀጥታ ወይም በበኩሉ ይነካሉ። የዓለም አቀፍ ግንኙነት ቲዮሪዎች (IR Theories) እንደ መነፅር (Lenses) በማገልገል፣ እነዚህን ውስብስብ ዓለም አቀፋዊ ክስተቶች በጥንቃቄ ተንትነን እንድንረዳ ያስችሉናል።

1.7.1. Idealism / Liberalism

Liberalism in IR was historically referred to as a 'utopian' theory and is still recognized as such to some degree today. Its proponents view human beings as innately good and believe peace and harmony between nations is not only achievable, but highly desirable. Immanuel Kant (late 18th century) posited that shared liberal values should give liberal states no reason to go to war against one another, a concept developed into the Democratic Peace Theory.

Following the devastation of WWI, US President Woodrow Wilson introduced his famous 'Fourteen Points' in January 1918, advocating for an association of nations that culminated in the establishment of the League of Nations (1920). Early liberal internationalism (1919–1930s) sought to replace the balance-of-power system with collective security, free trade over autarky, and institutionalized law-governed relations.

Role of International Law: International law provides the normative and operational framework for inter-state behavior, functioning through:
1. Operating System: Provides mechanisms for cross-border interactions.
2. Normative System: Shapes values and goals (e.g., International Human Rights Law regulating state treatment of individuals within/outside jurisdiction).

There are three competing views on international law: some view it as international morality; others as law in all senses; and others as a matter of definition (functioning like a constitution without a central enforcement body).

👉 የአማርኛ ማብራሪያ (Amharic Explanation):

ሊበራሊዝም (Idealism) የሰው ልጅ ተፈጥሮ መልካም ነው፣ ሰላምና ትብብርም በዓለም ላይ ይቻላል ብሎ ያምናል። ኢማኑኤል ካንት (Immanuel Kant) ዲሞክራሲያዊ ሀገራት እርስ በእርስ አይዋጉም (Democratic Peace Theory) የሚል እምነት ነበረው። ከአንደኛው የዓለም ጦርነት በኋላ የአሜሪካው ፕሬዝዳንት ውድሮው ቪልሰን (Woodrow Wilson) ባቀረቡት 'Fourteen Points' መሰረት እ.ኤ.አ በ1920 ሊግ ኦፍ ኔሽንስ (League of Nations) ተመሠረተ። ሊበራሎች በህብረት ደህንነት (Collective Security)፣ በነጻ ንግድ (Free Trade) እና በዓለም አቀፍ ህግ (International Law) አማካኝነት ሰላም ማምጣት ይቻላል ብለው ያምናሉ።

😅 EthioFresh Humor Break:
ሊበራሊዝም ማለት ግቢ ውስጥ ገና ስትገቡ "ሁሉም የዶርሜ ተማሪ መልካም ነው፣ ኖቴንም ሰርቆ አይወስድብኝም፣ አብረን በጥናት A+ እናመጣለን" ብሎ እንደማመን ያለ የዋህነትና በጎ አመለካከት ነው!
💡 Exam Hint:
በፈተና ላይ Immanuel Kant, Woodrow Wilson, Democratic Peace Theory, League of Nations, Collective Security, እና International Law ከLiberalism / Idealism ጋር እንደሚዛመዱ በደንብ ያዙ!

1.7.2. Realism

Emerging forcefully after the collapse of the League of Nations and the outbreak of WWII, Realism critiques liberal idealism as 'utopian' and futile. E.H. Carr in 'The Twenty Years' Crisis' (1939) called for a scientific approach separating 'what is' from 'what ought to be'. Realism traces its roots back to historical thinkers like Thucydides (Peloponnesian War), Niccolò Machiavelli, and Thomas Hobbes (who characterized human interaction in an order-less state of nature as a 'war of all against all').

Hans Morgenthau, in Politics Among Nations (1948), established realism's core premise: "All politics is a struggle for power." National interest is defined in terms of power.

Neorealism / Structural Realism: Advanced by Kenneth Waltz in Man, the State and War (1959) and Theory of International Politics (1979). Waltz shifts focus from human nature/state attributes to the anarchic structure of the international system, arguing that international anarchy forces all states into self-help, relative power calculations, and survival strategies, making war seem inevitable.

Hedley Bull and the English School: Bull criticized Morgenthau’s rigid focus on power, arguing in 'The Anarchical Society' (1977) that an 'international society' with rules of conduct exists alongside anarchy.

👉 የአማርኛ ማብራሪያ (Amharic Explanation):

ሪአሊዝም (Realism) ሁለተኛው የዓለም ጦርነት ሲቀሰቀስ የሊበራሊዝምን ህልመኝነት በመቃወም የወጣ ቲዮሪ ነው። E.H. Carr እና Hans Morgenthau "ዓለም አቀፍ ፖለቲካ የኃይል ሽሚያ ነው" ብለዋል። ቶማስ ሆብስ (Thomas Hobbes) የሰውን ልጅ ተፈጥሮ ስግብግብ ሲል ገልጾታል። ኬኔዝ ዋልትዝ (Kenneth Waltz) ደግሞ በኒዎ-ሪአሊዝም (Neorealism) ሀገራት የሚጣሉበት ዋና ምክንያት በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ የበላይ ተቆጣጣሪ መንግስት አለመኖሩ (Anarchy) ነው ብሏል።

😅 EthioFresh Humor Break:
ሪአሊዝም ማለት ደግሞ በግቢ ህይወት "ማንም ሰው በነጻ ኖት አይሰጥህም፣ ሁሉም የራሱን A+ ለማምጣት ነው የሚታገለው፣ ስለዚህ የራስህን ኖት በራስህ ያዝ (Self-help)!" ብሎ ማሰብ ነው!
💡 Exam Hint:
በፈተና ላይ Hans Morgenthau ("politics is a struggle for power"), E.H. Carr, Kenneth Waltz (Structural Realism / Anarchy), Thomas Hobbes, እና State-centric view ከRealism / Neorealism ጋር ይያያዛሉ!

1.7.3. Structuralism / Marxism

Marxism is an ideology arguing that capitalist society is divided into two contradictory classes: the business class (bourgeoisie) and the working class (proletariat). Inspired by Marx and Lenin, structuralism views the international system through the lens of economic inequality, class conflict, exploitation, and international division of labor. Decolonization and the rise of a Third World alliance shifted focus beyond Cold War rhetoric to regional integration and economic relations.

Foremost scholars like John Burton introduced pluralism by incorporating non-state actors and individuals. However, neo-Marxist structuralists like Andre Gunder Frank and Samir Amin developed Dependency Theory, illustrating how the impoverishment of peripheral developing nations is structurally caused by core capitalist economies. Immanuel Wallerstein formulated World-Systems Analysis, providing a historicist account of global capitalism from the 16th century to the present, creating a fundamental divide between the rich 'North' (Core) and the poor 'South' (Periphery).

👉 የአማርኛ ማብራሪያ (Amharic Explanation):

ማርክሲዝም/ስትራክቸራሊዝም በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ያለውን የኢኮኖሚ ብዝበዛና የእኩልነት ማጣትን ያተኩራል። በካፒታሊዝም ምክንያት በሀብታም ሀገራት ('North' / Core) እና በድሃ ሀገራት ('South' / Periphery) መካከል የብዝበዛ ግንኙነት ተፈጥሯል። Andre Gunder Frank (Dependency Theory) እና Immanuel Wallerstein (World-Systems Analysis) ታዋቂ ቲዮሪስቶች ናቸው።

💡 Exam Hint:
የእኩልነት ማጣት (Inequality)፣ ካፒታሊዝም፣ Dependency Theory (Samir Amin, Andre Gunder Frank) እና World-Systems Analysis (Immanuel Wallerstein) ከStructuralism/Marxism ጋር ይዛመዳሉ።

1.7.4. Constructivism

Constructivism represents a middle-ground perspective between mainstream theories and critical approaches, highlighting the importance of shared ideas, norms, values, and identities in shaping international relations. Prominent constructivist Alexander Wendt famously stated: "Anarchy is what states make of it" (1992). Constructivists argue that states interact through human agents (diplomats, politicians) based on socially constructed perceptions and evolving norms.

Case Study - 2003 Iraq War:
1. Realist View: The US invaded Iraq driven by national interest and security, ignoring the UN because international organizations only work when aligned with powerful state interests.
2. Liberal View: Bypassing the UN creates systemic instability because international organizations provide a crucial framework for cooperation and international law.
3. Constructivist View: Bypassing the UN violated established international norms. Even without formal physical punishment, the US's irregular behavior caused reputational loss and international relation difficulties because social norms carry real weight.

👉 የአማርኛ ማብራሪያ (Amharic Explanation):

ኮንስትራክቲቪዝም (Constructivism) ዓለም አቀፍ ግንኙነት በማህበራዊ እሴቶች፣ በባህልና በሀሳቦች (Shared Ideas & Norms) የሚቃኝ ነው ይላል። አሌክሳንደር ዌንት (Alexander Wendt) "Anarchy is what states make of it" ሲል ገልጾታል። የ2003ቱ የአሜሪካ የኢራቅ ወረራ በምሳሌነት ሲወሰድ፤ ኮንስትራክቲቪስቶች አሜሪካ የተባበሩት መንግስታትን አልፋ መውረሯ የዓለም አቀፍ ህግና ደንብ (Norms) ጥሰት በመሆኑ የስም እና የዲፕሎማሲ ጉዳት አድርሶባታል ይላሉ።

💡 Exam Hint:
Alexander Wendt, Shared Norms/Values, Social Construction, እና "Anarchy is what states make of it" የConstructivism መለያዎች ናቸው!

1.7.5. Critical Theories (Marxist Critical, Post-colonialism, Feminist Perspectives)

Critical approaches respond to mainstream approaches (Realism and Liberalism) by opposing long-held central assumptions and giving voice to marginalized populations, particularly women and those from the Global South.

Marxist Critical View of UN: Argues that international bodies like the UN serve capitalist/imperial interests of the business class, acting as mere 'band-aids' over state-led exploitation rather than offering true emancipation.

Post-colonialism: Differs from Marxism by focusing on inequalities between nations or regions rather than strictly class divisions, tracing back to Cold War decolonization. Edward Said (1978) introduced the 'Orientalist' critique, showing how Western scholars misrepresent the Global South. Post-colonialists critique the UN Security Council for having no African or Latin American permanent veto-holding members, perpetuating indirect colonial exploitation.

👉 የአማርኛ ማብራሪያ (Amharic Explanation):

ክሪቲካል ቲዮሪዎች (Critical Theories) ነባሮቹን ሪአሊዝምና ሊበራሊዝምን ይሞግታሉ። በተለይም ፖስት-ኮሎኒያሊዝም (Post-colonialism) በኤድዋርድ ሰኢድ (Edward Said - Orientalism) ተመስርቶ በሀብታምና በድሃ/በቀድሞ colonized ሀገራት መካከል ያለውን እኩልነት ማጣት ያሳያል። ለምሳሌ የተባበሩት መንግስታት ጸጥታው ምክር ቤት (UN Security Council) ለአፍሪካና ላቲን አሜሪካ ቋሚ የቪቶ (Veto) ወንበር አለመስጠቱ አሁንም የቅኝ ግዛት የበላይነት መኖሩን ያሳያል ይላሉ።

🎉 እንኳን ደስ አላችሁ! የምዕራፍ 1 የመጨረሻ ክፍል (1.7.1 - 1.7.5) የቲዮሪ ትንተናዎችን ሙሉ በሙሉ አጠናቅቀናል። ይህንን ኖት በጥንቃቄ በማንበብና በመከለስ በፈተናችሁ ላይ የሚመጡትን የማዛመድ፣ የምርጫና የእውነት/ሐሰት ጥያቄዎች በቀላሉ በመመለስ ያስችላችኃል። በርቱ፤ መልካም የጥናትና የፈተና ጊዜ ይሁንላችሁ! 🎓✨
